query:
WITH latest_matching AS (
                    SELECT id, timestamp
                    FROM user_activities
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                      AND activity = $2
                      AND related_entity_id = $3
                    ORDER BY timestamp DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                    FOR UPDATE
                ),
                latest_any AS (
                    SELECT id
                    FROM user_activities
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                    ORDER BY timestamp DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                )
                SELECT
                    lm.id AS "match_id?",
                    lm.timestamp AS "match_ts?",
                    la.id AS "any_id?"
                FROM latest_matching lm
                FULL OUTER JOIN latest_any la ON TRUE
